items.prompt: Repaint the supplied original game card Shooting as a square illustration. Input 1 is the original edit target. No person or hands. Simplify engraved metal into a few broad structural marks. Background is quiet charcoal green-gray solid color masses. Inputs 2-4 are drawing-style only. Matte muted colors with concentrated accents. No fine strands, dense wrinkles, facet mosaics, glossy rendering or all-over texture filters. Pure-color abstract backdrop; elements only as symbolic imagery. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
